newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets Feb interest rate subsidy at 2.09 pct.
newsitem.headline: China sets Feb interest rate subsidy at 2.09 pct.

text.p: The central People's Bank of China has set the February interest rate subsidy on bank deposits of three years or more at 2.09 percent, the official Financial News said on Thursday.
The rate was down from 2.87 percent in January.
The subsidy, paid on fixed deposits as they fall due, was added to normal interest rates in order to attract long-term deposits during a period of high inflation.
China stopped paying the subsidy on new deposits in April because of falling inflation.
The subsidy was introduced in March, 1994 and hit a record 13.24 percent in December, 1995.
